what: Live-sensor gates. Radiation and weather change by the hour and are the same over this 2.4 x 3 km box, so they are NOT painted as maps. Each sensor gives one GO / CAUTION / NO-GO for the whole map at that moment; the app combines them with the terrain map.

map_rule.CAUTION: terrain map as is + banner: shorten the EVA, stay within the return-reserve ring
map_rule.NO-GO: whole map NO-GO except the shelter: return / stay inside
map_rule.UNKNOWN: a feed is stale or missing: whole map grey (hold or send the scout)

combine.certainty: a live reading is the highest certainty level (team ladder: live > rover ground truth > orbital > none)

stale_after_hours.note: older readings turn the gate UNKNOWN (grey)

gates.label: Radiation dose rate

baseline.meaning: average galactic-cosmic-ray dose equivalent rate measured by Curiosity's RAD at Gale crater, Aug 2012 - Jun 2013

sources.who: SwRI press release on Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343
Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343 (absorbed dose 0.210 +/- 0.040 mGy/day)

gates.CAUTION: 2-10 x baseline (1.34-6.7): possible solar particle event onset
gates.NO-GO: > 10 x baseline (> 6.7) or a solar-particle-event alert: shelter
gates.status: ASSUMPTION (multipliers chosen by the team; baseline is measured)

gates.label: Career dose budget
gates.unit: mSv (cumulative effective dose per crew member)

limit.meaning: NASA career effective dose limit (NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 Rev. B)

sources.who: NASA OCHMO Radiation Protection technical brief

gates.label: Dust opacity (tau)
gates.feed: sky camera / mast camera opacity (REMS/MEDA-type station)
gates.CAUTION: 1.0-2.0 (low visibility, dust on suits and panels)

context.what: Opportunity was lost to the 2018 planet-encircling dust storm
MEDA (Perseverance) opacity from SkyCam; data in PDS
MEDA wind sensor damaged by saltating sand: wind data need care

gates.label: Suit O2 left after the walk back
gates.unit: minutes of oxygen left on return to base
gates.feed: suit telemetry + route length back to base from the map (team app: walk 0.8 m/s, way back +20 %)
gates.NO-GO: < 30 min (the team's reserve that is never planned into: turn back now)
gates.status: NO-GO line = team value (ASSUMPTIONS.md: 30 min reserve, NASA ISS EVA planning); CAUTION line 60 min = ASSUMPTION (2 x reserve)

simulation_note: The viewer moves these values with sliders (SIMULATED). In the real app each value comes from its live feed.
